fun_facts: Amon-Ra St. Brown was born in Anaheim Hills, California.
From childhood, Amon-Ra St. Brown spoke English, German, and French fluently.
Amon-Ra St. Brown started playing soccer at age five, when he joined a soccer club in Leverkusen, Germany.
At 15, Amon-Ra St. Brown won MVP honors at the European Championship in Dresden, Germany.
Amon-Ra St. Brown has a post-practice routine of catching exactly 202 balls on a Jugs machine; he started the routine in middle school.
As a rookie, Amon-Ra St. Brown set Lions single-season records for a rookie with 90 receptions and 912 receiving yards.
